createAccount(address,uint256).notice: Deploys a new smart account deterministically.

userdoc.notice: Deploys minimal proxy Smart Accounts deterministically with secure initialization.

devdoc.details: Enforcement model (defense in depth): 1. WHITELIST — preCheck reverts if call target not approved 2. METHOD BLOCKLIST — blocks approve, increaseAllowance, transferFrom drains 3. PRE/POST BALANCE DELTA — snapshot before, enforce limit after 4. CUMULATIVE SPEND CAP — lifetime spend bounded at install 5. PAUSE — owner can emergency-stop all agent execution postCheck runs INSIDE the userOp execution. Violation reverts atomically. Agent session key can sign ops, but cannot push funds past hook limits. Only smart account owner can change whitelist/limits — session key has no permission to touch firewall config.

postCheck(bytes).details: If balance grew or held flat, nothing spent.

preCheck(address,uint256,bytes).details: Blocks: non-whitelisted targets, blocked selectors, paused accounts.

params.smartAccount: The address of the Smart Account to pause.

contracts/ACEGuard.vy.content:
# pragma version ^0.4.0
"""
@title ACEGuard Delegate
@notice EIP-7702 delegate contract enforcing bitmasks, session keys, and velocity bounds.
"""

# =============================================================
# Events
# =============================================================
event Executed:
    caller: indexed(address)
    target: indexed(address)
    value: uint256
    success: bool

event SessionKeySet:
    key: indexed(address)
    expires: uint256

event SessionKeyRevoked:
    key: indexed(address)

# =============================================================
# Structs & Storage
# =============================================================
struct EpochState:
    last_epoch: uint256
    calls: uint256
    value_spent: uint256

initialized: public(bool)
owner: public(address)

session_keys: public(HashMap[address, uint256])
epoch_states: public(HashMap[address, HashMap[address, EpochState]])

max_calls_per_epoch: public(uint256)
max_value_per_epoch: public(uint256)
epoch_duration: public(uint256)

allowed_targets: public(HashMap[address, bool])
is_allowed_selector: public(HashMap[bytes4, bool])

# =============================================================
# Initialization
# =============================================================
@external
def setup(
    _owner: address,
    _max_calls: uint256,
    _max_value: uint256,
    _epoch_duration: uint256
):
    assert not self.initialized, "Already initialized"
    assert _epoch_duration > 0, "Invalid duration"
    assert _owner != empty(address), "Invalid owner"

    self.owner = _owner
    self.initialized = True
    
    self.max_calls_per_epoch = _max_calls
    self.max_value_per_epoch = _max_value
    self.epoch_duration = _epoch_duration

# =============================================================
# Owner Configuration
# =============================================================
@external
def setSessionKey(key: address, duration: uint256):
    assert msg.sender == self.owner or msg.sender == self, "Not owner"

    new_expiration: uint256 = block.timestamp + duration
    self.session_keys[key] = new_expiration
    log SessionKeySet(key, new_expiration)

@external
def revokeSessionKey(key: address):
    assert msg.sender == self.owner or msg.sender == self, "Not owner"
    self.session_keys[key] = 0
    log SessionKeyRevoked(key)

@external
def setAllowedSelector(selector: bytes4, allowed: bool):
    assert msg.sender == self.owner or msg.sender == self, "Not owner"
    self.is_allowed_selector[selector] = allowed

@external
def setAllowedTarget(target: address, allowed: bool):
    assert msg.sender == self.owner or msg.sender == self, "Not owner"
    self.allowed_targets[target] = allowed

@external
def reset():
    assert msg.sender == self.owner or msg.sender == self, "Not owner"

    self.initialized = False
    self.owner = empty(address)

    self.max_calls_per_epoch = 0
    self.max_value_per_epoch = 0
    self.epoch_duration = 0


# =============================================================
# Execution
# =============================================================
@external
@payable
def execute(
    target: address,
    calldata: Bytes[1024]
) -> Bytes[1024]:
    caller: address = msg.sender
    
    # 1. Authorization check: Owner and self bypass session expiration
    if caller != self.owner and caller != self:
        expiry: uint256 = self.session_keys[caller]
        assert expiry > 0 and block.timestamp <= expiry, "Session invalid or expired"

    # 2. Selector check
    assert len(calldata) >= 4, "Calldata too short"
    target_selector: bytes4 = convert(slice(calldata, 0, 4), bytes4)
    assert self.is_allowed_selector[target_selector], "Unauthorized Selector"

    # 3. Target check 
    assert self.allowed_targets[target], "Target not allowed"

    # 4. Epoch velocity limits
    current_epoch: uint256 = block.timestamp // self.epoch_duration
    state: EpochState = self.epoch_states[caller][target]

    if state.last_epoch != current_epoch:
        state.calls = 0
        state.value_spent = 0
        state.last_epoch = current_epoch

    assert state.calls < self.max_calls_per_epoch, "ACE: Call limit"
    assert state.value_spent + msg.value <= self.max_value_per_epoch, "ACE: Value limit"

    state.calls += 1
    state.value_spent += msg.value

    # Commit memory struct back to storage mapping
    self.epoch_states[caller][target] = state

    # 5. Raw execution call
    response: Bytes[1024] = raw_call(
        target,
        calldata,
        max_outsize=1024,
        value=msg.value,
        revert_on_failure=True
    )

    log Executed(caller, target, msg.value, True)
    return response

@external
@payable
def __default__():
    pass

contracts/AccountFactory.vy.content:
# @version ^0.4.3
"""
@title Production-Grade ERC-4337 Account Factory
@notice Deploys minimal proxy Smart Accounts deterministically with secure initialization.
"""

interface ISmartAccount:
    def initialize(_owner: address): nonpayable

accountImplementation: public(immutable(address))

event AccountCreated:
    account: indexed(address)
    owner: indexed(address)
    salt: uint256

@deploy
def __init__(_implementation: address):
    assert _implementation != empty(address), "Invalid implementation"
    accountImplementation = _implementation

@external
def createAccount(owner: address, salt: uint256) -> address:
    """
    @notice Deploys a new smart account deterministically.
    @dev CREATE2 handles collision safety; reverts if already deployed with the same salt.
    """
    assert owner != empty(address), "Invalid owner"

    # Bind salt with owner to isolate namespaces per owner
    combinedSalt: bytes32 = keccak256(concat(convert(owner, bytes32), convert(salt, bytes32)))
    
    deployedAccount: address = create_forwarder_to(
        accountImplementation,
        salt=combinedSalt
    )

    extcall ISmartAccount(deployedAccount).initialize(owner)
    log AccountCreated(deployedAccount, owner, salt)
    return deployedAccount

    self.admin = msg.sender
    log Transfer(empty(address), msg.sender, initial_supply)

@external
def mint(receiver: address, amount: uint256):
    assert msg.sender == self.admin, "Only admin can mint"
    self.totalSupply += amount
    self.balanceOf[receiver] += amount
    log Transfer(empty(address), receiver, amount)

@external
def transfer(to: address, _value: uint256) -> bool:
    assert to != empty(address), "Cannot transfer to zero address"
    self.balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value
    self.balanceOf[to] += _value
    log Transfer(msg.sender, to, _value)
    return True

@external
def transferFrom(sender: address, receiver: address, _value: uint256) -> bool:
    assert receiver != empty(address), "Cannot transfer to zero address"
    self.allowance[sender][msg.sender] -= _value
    self.balanceOf[sender] -= _value
    self.balanceOf[receiver] += _value
    log Transfer(sender, receiver, _value)
    return True

@external
def approve(spender: address, _value: uint256) -> bool:
    self.allowance[msg.sender][spender] = _value
    log Approval(msg.sender, spender, _value)
    return True

@external
@view
def name() -> String[32]:
    return NAME

@external
@view
def symbol() -> String[32]:
    return SYMBOL

@external
@view
def decimals() -> uint8:
    return DECIMALS

# @version ^0.4.3
"""
@title Production-Grade ERC-7579 Smart Account with Hook Firewall & ECDSA Validation
@notice Compliant with ERC-4337 and ERC-7579 with cryptographic verification and secure state management.
"""

interface IERC7579Hook:
    def isModuleType(moduleTypeId: uint256) -> bool: view
    def onInstall(data: Bytes[1024]): nonpayable
    def onUninstall(data: Bytes[1024]): nonpayable
    def preCheck(msgSender: address, msgValue: uint256, msgData: Bytes[8192]) -> Bytes[2048]: nonpayable
    def postCheck(hookData: Bytes[2048]): nonpayable

struct PackedUserOperation:
    sender: address
    nonce: uint256
    initCode: Bytes[1024]
    callData: Bytes[4096]
    accountGasLimits: bytes32
    preVerificationGas: uint256
    gasFees: bytes32
    paymasterAndData: Bytes[1024]
    signature: Bytes[1024]

MODULE_TYPE_HOOK: constant(uint256) = 4
SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED: constant(uint256) = 1

entryPoint: public(immutable(address))
owner: public(address)
isInitialized: public(bool)

installedModules: public(HashMap[uint256, HashMap[address, bool]])
activeHook: public(address)

event AccountInitialized:
    owner: indexed(address)
    entryPoint: indexed(address)

event ModuleInstalled:
    moduleTypeId: indexed(uint256)
    module: indexed(address)

event ModuleUninstalled:
    moduleTypeId: indexed(uint256)
    module: indexed(address)

event ExecutionSuccess:
    target: indexed(address)
    value: uint256

@deploy
def __init__(_entryPoint: address):
    assert _entryPoint != empty(address), "Invalid EntryPoint"
    entryPoint = _entryPoint
    # Lock implementation contract to prevent master copy hijacking
    self.owner = 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD
    self.isInitialized = True

@external
def initialize(_owner: address):
    """
    @notice Called by Factory immediately after deployment. Can only be called once.
    """
    assert not self.isInitialized, "Already initialized"
    assert _owner != empty(address), "Invalid owner"
    
    self.owner = _owner
    self.isInitialized = True
    log AccountInitialized(_owner, entryPoint)

@external
def validateUserOp(
    userOp: PackedUserOperation,
    userOpHash: bytes32,
    missingAccountFunds: uint256
) -> uint256:
    """
    @notice ERC-4337 entry point validation hook with cryptographic signature verification.
    """
    assert msg.sender == entryPoint, "Only EntryPoint can validate"

    # 1. Reimburse EntryPoint if required during validation
    if missingAccountFunds > 0:
        raw_call(entryPoint, b"", value=missingAccountFunds)

    # 2. Cryptographic Signature Verification (ECDSA via ecrecover)
    assert len(userOp.signature) == 65, "Invalid signature length"
    
    r: bytes32 = convert(slice(userOp.signature, 0, 32), bytes32)
    s: bytes32 = convert(slice(userOp.signature, 32, 32), bytes32)
    v: uint256 = convert(slice(userOp.signature, 64, 1), uint256)
    
    if v < 27:
        v += 27

    recoveredSigner: address = ecrecover(userOpHash, v, r, s)
    
    if recoveredSigner != self.owner or recoveredSigner == empty(address):
        return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED

    # 0 indicates signature validation success (ERC-4337 standard)
    return 0

@external
def installModule(moduleTypeId: uint256, module: address, initData: Bytes[1024]):
    """
    @notice ERC-7579 compliant module installation. Supports Type 4 Hooks.
    """
    assert msg.sender == self.owner or msg.sender == self, "Unauthorized"
    assert not self.installedModules[moduleTypeId][module], "Module already installed"

    if moduleTypeId == MODULE_TYPE_HOOK:
        assert self.activeHook == empty(address), "Hook already installed"
        assert staticcall IERC7579Hook(module).isModuleType(MODULE_TYPE_HOOK), "Invalid Hook module type"
        self.activeHook = module

    self.installedModules[moduleTypeId][module] = True
    
    extcall IERC7579Hook(module).onInstall(initData)
    log ModuleInstalled(moduleTypeId, module)

@external
def uninstallModule(moduleTypeId: uint256, module: address, deInitData: Bytes[1024]):
    """
    @notice ERC-7579 compliant module uninstallation.
    """
    assert msg.sender == self.owner or msg.sender == self, "Unauthorized"
    assert self.installedModules[moduleTypeId][module], "Module not installed"

    if moduleTypeId == MODULE_TYPE_HOOK:
        assert self.activeHook == module, "Not active hook"
        self.activeHook = empty(address)

    self.installedModules[moduleTypeId][module] = False
    
    extcall IERC7579Hook(module).onUninstall(deInitData)
    log ModuleUninstalled(moduleTypeId, module)

@external
@payable
def execute(mode: bytes32, executionCalldata: Bytes[8192]) -> Bytes[4096]:
    """
    @notice ERC-7579 execution entrypoint. Intercepts transaction with HookV1 firewall.
    """
    assert msg.sender == entryPoint or msg.sender == self.owner, "Not authorized"

    hook: address = self.activeHook
    hookData: Bytes[2048] = b""

    # 1. FIREWALL PRE-CHECK INTERCEPTION
    # Pass executionCalldata directly since its type (Bytes[8192]) matches the interface
    if hook != empty(address):
        hookData = extcall IERC7579Hook(hook).preCheck(
            msg.sender, msg.value, executionCalldata
        )

    # 2. DECODE EXECUTION PAYLOAD (Single Call Format)
    assert len(executionCalldata) >= 52, "Malformed execution calldata"
    target: address = convert(slice(executionCalldata, 0, 20), address)
    value: uint256 = convert(slice(executionCalldata, 20, 32), uint256)
    
    callData: Bytes[8192] = b""
    if len(executionCalldata) > 52:
        callData = slice(executionCalldata, 52, len(executionCalldata) - 52)

    # 3. ATOMIC EXECUTION
    result: Bytes[4096] = raw_call(
        target,
        callData,
        max_outsize=4096,
        value=value
    )
    log ExecutionSuccess(target, value)

    # 4. FIREWALL POST-CHECK ENFORCEMENT
    if hook != empty(address):
        extcall IERC7579Hook(hook).postCheck(hookData)

    return result

@external
@payable
def __default__():
    pass
